acceptance_criteria.criterion: find/route.ts's suggestions catch RETURNS A DESCENDING FIELD, ported from the exemplar in the same file at :56-60 (binds `err`, threads a message, keeps the status deliberate). Proven by a test that forces the upstream failure and asserts the field carries the reason. Evidence quotes the test run.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: web/app/api/find/route.ts now binds err, threads message into a typed SuggestionsResponse {popular,nohits,error} at status 200 (error:null on the success path). New web/__tests__/find-suggestions-receipt.test.ts drives the REAL undici transport (a local http server, because bp-fetch dispatches through undici's own fetch — a globalThis.fetch stub is never consulted). Run: 'upstream 500: the empty list carries the reason it is empty' PASS (asserts error matches /search engine is down/ and status 200); 'upstream 200 that is not JSON at all: the reason still descends' PASS (/non-JSON/); 'upstream 200: the suggestions pass through and error is null' PASS; 'upstream 200 with an EMPTY corpus: still null' PASS. Mutation-proved: reverting the catch to the bare {popular:[],nohits:[]} makes the two failure arms RED (MUTANT_RC=1, 4 fail across both new files).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: search-seed IS EITHER REPAIRED OR CLASSIFIED lawful-invisible-degrade IN WRITING, and the writing engages its DECLARED consumer - the 'explicit fetchable endpoint for tooling / diagnostics' asserted at :18-20 - rather than waving at it. A classification that does not explain how a diagnostics consumer distinguishes engine-down from empty-corpus is refused.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: REPAIRED, not classified. buildSeed now returns SeedPayload (extends PrefixSeed, so SSR/browser consumers reading index+docs are unaffected) carrying error:null on an engine answer and 'seed build failed: <upstream reason>' on a failure; GET answers 503 + Cache-Control:no-store when seed.error is set, 200 + s-maxage=3600 otherwise. The declared tooling/diagnostics consumer sees the HTTP answer and nothing else, so it now distinguishes engine-down from empty-corpus TWO ways: res.ok (503 vs 200) and the body's error field. no-store keeps a seconds-long outage from being pinned in the hour-long edge cache. Tests in web/__tests__/search-seed-receipt.test.ts, all PASS: 'engine down: the empty index says so, in the body AND on the status line' (503 + error matching /search engine is down/ and /500/); 'engine answered with an EMPTY corpus: 200 and error stays null'; 'engine down: the failure is NOT pinned in the hour-long edge cache'; 'the success answer keeps its cache header'.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: THE POPULATION IS STATED AND CORRECT: web/app/api/ holds FIVE routes, enumerated by `git ls-tree`, not by a glob. Evidence quotes the enumeration.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: $ git ls-tree -r --name-only origin/main web/app/api/  ->  web/app/api/admin/reindex/route.ts | web/app/api/barkpark/webhook/route.ts | web/app/api/find-event/route.ts | web/app/api/find/route.ts | web/app/api/search-seed/route.ts  = FIVE routes, run in the worktree against origin/main. Two repaired here, one (find-event) already repaired by #9599, two untouched because they bind honestly.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: admin/reindex AND barkpark/webhook ARE UNTOUCHED, and the PR states why both bind honestly (webhook's revalidated field is request-derived at :161 and revalidateTag returns void; reindex has a typed error body at :57). A criterion written against 'the 5 web routes' would send a builder to repair four honest things.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: git show --stat 7e08e1ce6 touches exactly four paths: web/app/api/find/route.ts, web/app/api/search-seed/route.ts, web/__tests__/find-suggestions-receipt.test.ts, web/__tests__/search-seed-receipt.test.ts — admin/reindex and barkpark/webhook are not in the diff. The commit message (which becomes the PR body) carries the paragraph beginning 'The other two routes are deliberately UNTOUCHED because they already bind honestly:' and names both reasons — webhook's revalidated descends from tagsFor(payload) at :161 while revalidateTag returns void, and admin/reindex has a real catch at :47 with a typed error body at :57 — plus the note that a change written against 'the 5 web routes' would have repaired four honest things.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: NO LINE-DISTANCE CLAIM APPEARS ANYWHERE. The PR body and any comment cite line numbers, never 'N lines below' - the original row's 'eleven lines' was itself wrong (it is 27).
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Scanned both the commit message and every changed file: $ git log -1 --format=%B | grep -niE 'lines below|[0-9]+ lines|line(s)? (below|above|apart|away)|eleven' -> NO_DISTANCE_CLAIM_FOUND; $ grep -rniE 'lines below|lines above|[0-9]+ lines' <the four changed files> -> NO_DISTANCE_CLAIM_IN_DIFF. Every reference is a line number (:27-29, :56-60, :18-20, :161, :47, :57); no distance is asserted anywhere, and this stamp names none either.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: THE LOCAL GATES PASS, with both runs quoted: `cd web && pnpm test` (node --test over __tests__/*.test.ts with the server-only stub) and `cd web && pnpm typecheck`.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Run in the worktree on branch loop-epic/two-sibling-web-routes-launder-alongside-5 at commit 7e08e1ce6, exit codes captured separately (never through a pipe): $ cd web && pnpm test -> TEST_RC=0, 'tests 307 / pass 307 / fail 0' (up from 298 — the 9 new arms). $ cd web && pnpm typecheck -> TYPECHECK_RC=0, tsc --noEmit clean, no output. $ git ls-tree -r --name-only origin/main web/app/api/ -> the five routes. NOTE for reproducers: this worktree needed 'pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts' in web/ (sharp's source build fails on this host and aborts bin linking) plus 'pnpm build' in js/packages/core and js/packages/react, which the file: deps resolve to.
